Located on the first floor of the Intercontinental Hotel, Trenasse is one of this city's gems when it comes to new modern Cajun cuisine. I went to Trenasse for brunch and indulged in their $10 bottomless mimosas. While I will agree that you must go for their blue crab omelette, you'll stay for ever other menu item, because they're all good! I started off with the crab bisque and a friend ordered the boudin balls, which are served with a colorful side salad. We also ordered the lamb chops and grits and grillades with breakfast potatoes. Everything was delicious and priced more along $$-$$$. Service was excellent, even though it was a little slow due to the full house. Looking forward to co...

First time dining here last night. The food did not disappoint. We ordered a lot mainly because we wanted to try as much as we could. To recap what was ordered: The Oyster Platter which was 18 oysters in 6 different ways and it was all delicious. The hot garlic french bread, which is exactly what it sounds like, I was disappointed because I was expecting something else and not just a loaf of bread coated in garlic. The escargot, I do enjoy escargot but it lacked a little something. The crawfish hot tamale, which hands down was amazing. It was full of flavor and definitely had a kick.
